shape_hint: Truss head: very low, wide, gently domed head (diameter A about 2.3 x D, height H about 0.6 x D) with a flat bearing face, slotted or cross recessed, on a threaded shank. Binding head: slightly smaller diameter head with tapered/rounded sides and a flat top 'oval' crown (total height O, crown height F), slotted, on a threaded shank.
notes: INCH ASME B18.6.3 only; the KS B 1023 / JIS B 1111 metric truss/binding table could not be verified (see dropped). Sizes #0..3/8 only (13 rows). Thread pitch is not included here: use the UNC/UNF TPI of the same size from the ms-inch table (#2..1/2). Truss head table in the standard continues to 3/4 (7/16..3/4 values had 3 sources) but cannot be published here because the binding head columns do not exist above 3/8. ASME slotted binding head is slotted only (a binding head is also made undercut, columns U, X exist in the sources but were left out). 18 columns = at the limit. Independence of torqbolt vs boltingspecialist vs globalfastener is assumed from distinct layouts; row support is exactly 3 (binding and R columns have only these 3 sites).

verification.checks_done: Re-downloaded all 8 listed URLs live (all 200). Parsed torqbolt truss (21 rows x 9 cols) and binding (16 rows x 14 cols), boltingspecialist truss/binding/cross-truss, gf 4995 (21 rows) and 4998 (16 rows), AFT truss chart (#2..1/2, 12 rows). Compared all 13 rows x 17 value columns (221 cells) of the record against every source listing them: 0 disagreements (only the bs cross-truss 5/16 A max 0.68 vs 0.698, which is outside the cluster that matters and not in the record). Full-table cross-diff of the three transcriptions over ALL their rows (truss 189 cells, binding 212 cells): torq vs bs 0 diffs, torq vs gf 0, bs vs gf 0. Cluster counts: truss At/Ht/J/Tt = 4 clusters for rows #2..3/8, 3 for #0,#1 (AFT starts at #2); Rt_max = 3 (torq,bs,gf; AFT has no R); all 8 binding columns = 3 (torq,bs,gf; no other binding source - engineersedge/china-bolts truss/binding pages are 404/empty, AFT has no binding page). J_max/J_min identical in truss and binding tables of all three sources (so shared column is valid). Sanity: max>min everywhere, all columns non-decreasing with size, At>Ab on all rows, Fb<Ob, At/D = 2.18-2.27. Independence torq vs bs: same evidence as ms-inch (different companies, different markup, binding footnotes worded differently - torq 'a/b' table footnotes vs bs 'Notes: Break sharp edge...', no shared typos); fasteners.eu has no ASME B18.6.3.
problems: LABEL MISMATCH (decisive for 'fix'): family is '+자 트러스머리·바인드머리 작은나사' (KS B 1023, sys both) but the record is ASME SLOTTED truss + SLOTTED binding head, inch only. Slot columns J,Tt,Tb and all 8 binding columns do not describe a cross-recessed screw, and no source shows a cross-recessed binding head. Cross-recessed truss A/H being equal to slotted is evidenced by only 2 clusters (AFT 'Slotted & Phillips' chart, bs cross truss page; gf 4996/4997 returned empty, torqbolt cross pages 404). Publish only under a slotted (일자홈) truss/binding label, inch ASME B18.6.3, not as the '+자' family or as the metric/KS part.

Exactly 3 clusters (torq, bs, gf) on the 8 binding columns, Rt_max, and on truss At/Ht/J/Tt for rows #0,#1: all rest on torqbolt != boltingspecialist. Judged independent (see checks_done). If the owner merges them: drop cols Rt_max, Ab_*, Ob_*, Fb_*, Tb_* and rows #0,#1 (leaves At,Ht,J,Tt for #2..3/8).
Producer check 'truss head height H < binding total height O' is FALSE for #0..#5 (e.g. #1 0.045 vs 0.041); harmless to the data but the stated sanity check is wrong.
Metric KS B 1023 / JIS B 1111 truss/binding table not verified (producer dropped it): the 'sys: both' family has only the inch half.
Producer dropped truss rows 7/16..3/4 because binding stops at 3/8; truss-only columns for those rows have 3 clusters (could be a separate truss-only table).

Semantics read from headers: At/Ab = Head Dia A; Ht = Head Height H (truss); Ob = Total Head Height O; Fb = Head Oval Height F (gf 'k' and 'f'); Rt = Head Radius R max; J = Slot Width; Tt/Tb = Slot Depth T. Binding U,X (undercut) rightly left out.
